new_today_news.headline: Summer Travel & Dining Trends: Key Developments Shaping Restaurant Demand
new_today_news.summary: 55% of consumers plan overnight U.S. travel this summer and expect to dine out. Restaurants positioned for busy summer with travelers including dining as primary vacation activity despite economic concerns.

new_today_news.headline: New York Cracks Down on PFAS Amid Rising Wave of State Restrictions
new_today_news.summary: New York is advancing strict PFAS regulations including requirements for industrial, manufacturing, and sewage treatment plants to monitor and test wastewater for PFAS. The state's measures would establish the strictest rules in the nation, with momentum carrying into 2026 with nearly 100 more state bills introduced across 17 states.

new_today_news.headline: Tift County Landfill Tipping Fees Increase by Over 50%
new_today_news.summary: Tift County, Georgia announced significant tipping fee increases effective August 1, 2026, with the Inert Landfill for yard waste rising 55.6% from $18 to $28 per ton. The standard landfill rate increased 11% from $42 to $47 per ton to cover rising operational costs and capital improvements.

recent_news.headline: Michigan Restaurants Fight to Stay Afloat Amid Food, Drink Challenges
recent_news.summary: Michigan restaurants face record beef prices, labor cost increases, and declining alcohol sales. 51% of operators saw same-store sales decline in March as profitability pressures mount.

recent_news.headline: Restaurant Events LLC Launches Carolinas Restaurant Show
recent_news.summary: New annual Carolinas Restaurant Show announced for June 2027 in Charlotte, expanding trade show portfolio. Event will serve North Carolina and South Carolina hospitality markets worth $59B annually.

recent_news.headline: Landfill Gas Continues to Drive U.S. Renewable Natural Gas Growth
recent_news.summary: The American Biogas Council released new data showing landfills are the largest source of captured biogas in the U.S., with 598 landfill gas capture systems providing about three-quarters of all biogas captured. Developers brought 20 new landfill gas projects online in 2025, adding 39.9 billion cubic feet of new biogas capture capacity.

recent_news.headline: Crescent Constructors Awarded City of Lewisville Wastewater Treatment Plant Expansion
recent_news.summary: Crescent Constructors won the contract for the Prairie Creek Wastewater Treatment Plant expansion in Lewisville, Texas, increasing capacity from 12 MGD to 16 MGD through aeration basin expansion and system upgrades. Final completion is scheduled for November 2028, with the facility remaining operational during phased construction.
